items.title: SAYouth.mobi
items.desc: A free, mobile-friendly platform where young South Africans can find jobs, learnerships, internships and short courses, and build a profile that employers can see.

items.title: Youth Employment Service (YES)
items.desc: Year-long paid work experience placements with participating companies for young South Africans aged 18 to 35. Sign up and get matched.

items.title: Harambee Youth Employment Accelerator
items.desc: Connects young job-seekers to entry-level work opportunities and offers free work-readiness support before you apply.

items.title: Public Service Vacancy Circular
items.org: Department of Public Service and Administration
items.desc: The official, regularly updated list of vacancies across national and provincial government departments. Check the closing date on each post.

items.title: NYDA programmes and support
items.desc: Youth development programmes, including skills training, business support and grants. Look for your nearest NYDA branch.

items.title: LinkedIn Jobs
items.desc: One of the most active platforms for professional roles in South Africa. Set a job alert for your target title so new roles come to you.

items.title: Indeed South Africa
items.desc: A large general job board covering roles in every industry, with company reviews and salary information.

items.title: PNet
items.desc: A long-standing South African job board with listings from direct employers and recruitment agencies.
